title: Explore Hero
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: cinematic 16:9 website hero, broad urban architectural composition. Create an elevated architectural section-like photographic view across a contemporary Australian mixed urban precinct, with physically coherent real relationships between a tram stop, public library, health service, productive workshop spaces and apartments. Show believable facades, windows and a few cutaway or open building edges that reveal ordinary people using the spaces, without turning the image into a diagram. Contemporary Australian urban materials, concrete, brick, timber, rail infrastructure and realistic lighting. A coherent urban landscape at blue hour with warm practical windows, deep charcoal and steel-blue atmosphere, restrained amber and teal. Reserve the left third as quieter darker building mass and atmospheric urban shadow for a white heading added later. Main visual interest centre and right, with connected pedestrian routes, a tram, a library reading room, a clinic reception and a workshop all spatially plausible. Think serious architectural editorial photography of a human-scale city district. No labels, no readable text, no logos, no watermarks, no holograms, no robots, no gardens, farms or butterflies. Sophisticated material richness and purposeful social life.
alt: An imagined urban precinct connects housing, a tram stop, civic learning, healthcare and workshops.
caption: A connected urban precinct imagined as one place with many useful relationships.
review: Inspected for the requested subject, realistic material detail, quiet dark left-side composition, absence of prominent text or logos, and absence of garden or farm themes.
processing: Copied unchanged PNG from the built-in image generator; delivery variants resized and compressed with Pillow.
